tasks.short: Assess a patient's risk of harm to self or others

steps.what: Conduct assessments of patients on harm to self or others
Read earlier records of harm to self or others
Judge the risk of harm to self or to others
Tell the patient the assessment of harm to self or others

tasks.design: The harm assessment stays with the clinical psychologist. She conducts it in the room, reads earlier statements in {DOCS}, judges the risk, and tells the patient. No score and no draft decides harm to self or others.
tasks.previous_blocker: The risk turns on what the patient says and does in the room, which a form cannot settle.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new is required, because this task is not handed to a machine.
tasks.still_hard: She must still hear the patient, weigh the earlier record, and say the risk herself.
tasks.human_edge: Only she can judge whether this patient is at risk of harm to self or others.
tasks.altitude: Her week is unchanged. She still conducts the assessment and the harm call remains hers.

reach.task: Decide what a workplace safety file may hold about a person's risk
reach.learn: Which harm facts may leave the clinical note and which must stay in it

evidence.claim: A checklist score is not the judgement of harm to self or others. That call needs the person in the room.
Earlier harm statements in the clinical record are health data under GDPR Article 9.
GDPR Article 22 limits decisions based solely on automated processing. This design leaves the harm call with the psychologist.

assumptions: The focal boundary is the assessment itself: the room account, the earlier harm statement, the judgement, and the words she tells the patient.
No structured risk code is produced for a machine. She does not keep a mapping or a template for this task, so ongoing upkeep is zero.
Telling the patient is spoken in the room. It is not a versioned send.
unknowns: Whether a second clinician must hear a high-risk account before she tells the patient.
research_questions: Which harm statements must a second clinician hear before she tells the patient?

already_counted.description: The room assessment, the record read, the judgement and the conversation all stay her time.

incremental.description: No mapping or template to maintain. The assessment is not a configured list.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The room assessment, the record read, the harm judgement and the conversation with the patient all stay with her, so no time returns.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Document session notes, recommendations and treatment plans

steps.what: Read the last progress notes and current treatment plans
Document session points including recommendations and treatment changes
Draft session notes and progress notes from the stated points

loop.input: The consented recording and the recommendation, plan change and risk mention she stated in s2
loop.output: Draft session notes and progress notes
loop.check: Each sentence is a span of the recording or a restatement of a point she stated. Drop it if it adds a diagnosis, a medication, a risk level, or a plan she did not state.
loop.stop: One note for this session, then stop. If consent or the recording is missing, write nothing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Session speech is not a form. A fixed template cannot tell which sentence she said.

steps.what: Correct the draft against the patient information she heard
File the corrected notes and treatment plans into the care record

tasks.design: She reads the last plan in {DOCS} and, in the session, states the points the note must carry, including any recommendation or treatment change. A bounded draft then writes the session notes and progress notes from the consented recording and those points, and she corrects every clinical sentence. A separate gated post files only that corrected text into the care record in {OTHER}, a second entry after the document, not a save of the note she just corrected.
tasks.previous_blocker: Session speech did not arrive as fields, so a note had to be written out by hand and then retyped.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft can propose prose from a consented recording and from points she has already stated, and she still corrects it.
tasks.still_hard: She must still hear the patient, state the recommendation and the plan change, and correct anything the draft adds.
tasks.human_edge: She remains accountable for the note. The draft cannot add a diagnosis, a medication, a risk level, or a plan she did not state.
tasks.altitude: She still runs the session and corrects the note. She no longer composes the prose from scratch or retypes the accepted text into the care record.

reach.task: Decide which test scores a session note may quote
reach.learn: Which scores belong in the note and which stay in the test file

evidence.claim: 24 of 25 large mental-health providers in the Netherlands use speech-driven reporting. That shows the draft is done in the field. It is not this task's time cut.
At a London child mental health clinic, 10 clinicians cut median admin time per encounter from 27 minutes to 10 with ambient voice notes. Those are admin minutes, not this whole documentation task.
The psychologist stays accountable for notes drafted with AI.
Session notes are health data under GDPR Article 9.

assumptions: Today she writes the note as a document and retypes the accepted text into the care record. The ten-point file is that retype only. A save inside the same record is not counted.

s2 produces the fields the draft may use: recommendation, plan_change, and risk_mention, each a short text she states. The consented recording is the session audio from that same step. Blank consent means s3 and s5 do not run.
Note headings are fixed at build. She does not maintain a codebook or a field map afterwards, so focal upkeep is zero. Correction time sits in s4.
Patient consent for a recording, and any staff consultation, follow national rules.
unknowns: Whether this clinic retypes an accepted note into a separate care record, or writes the note only there.
research_questions: What share of sessions have a consented recording that can feed a note draft?

already_counted.description: Reading the last plan, stating the points, and correcting the draft stay her time.

incremental.description: No ongoing upkeep of headings or field maps. A heading change is a new build, not weekly work.

approvals.approved_version: The session notes, recommendations and treatment plans as corrected at s4. A later edit voids the file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the patient refuses a recording, or the note stays on paper, the draft and the file do not run. If she recorded with consent and already retypes the accepted note into the care record, most of the prose draft and part of that retype return. She still reads the last plan and corrects the note.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Diagnose disorders from interviews, tests and records

steps.what: Identify issues in interviews with the patient
Record information obtained from tests as raw scores
Scale the raw scores against the published norm table
Diagnose psychological emotional and behavioral disorders using interviews tests records and reference materials
Tell the patient which disorders were identified

tasks.design: She identifies the issues in the interview and records the raw scores herself. A deterministic lookup then scales those scores against the published norm table she named in {DOCS}. She still names the disorder from the interviews, the tests, the records and the reference materials, and she tells the patient. The lookup does not diagnose.
tasks.previous_blocker: Looking up a norm is arithmetic, but naming the disorder is not, so the whole task stayed with her.
tasks.enabler_now: The norm table is a fixed published table, so the arithmetic can run once she has entered the raw score.
tasks.still_hard: The interview and the diagnostic judgement stay with her, including when the scaled score and the history disagree.
tasks.human_edge: She decides whether the pattern is a disorder. A norm score does not.
tasks.altitude: She still interviews and diagnoses. The only change is that she no longer computes the norm by hand.

reach.task: Say which population a published norm table was built on
reach.learn: When a norm table does not fit this patient, so the scaled score must not be used

evidence.claim: Applying a published norm table to a raw score is fixed arithmetic. Naming the disorder is not.
Test results are health data under GDPR Article 9.
GDPR Article 22 limits decisions based solely on automated processing. The diagnosis stays her statement.

assumptions: s2 produces scale_id, raw_score and norm_table_id. A blank raw_score means the scale step does not run.
The norm table is the publisher's published table, stored once at build. She does not maintain a weekly catalogue. A publisher update is a new build, so focal upkeep is zero.
Patient records and reference materials already exist. She uses them while she diagnoses. No report is drafted in this task.
Telling the patient is spoken. It is not a versioned send, and the diagnosis is not filed again here.
unknowns: Which tests this clinic uses, and whether the publisher allows a local copy of the norm table.
research_questions: For which tests is the norm lookup a table join rather than a judgement?

already_counted.description: The interview, entering raw scores, the diagnosis and telling the patient stay her time.

incremental.description: No weekly norm-table upkeep. A publisher change is a new build.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If she does not use a published norm table, the scale step does not run. If she does, most of that arithmetic returns, and she still checks the scaled number before she diagnoses.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write client reports and keep the required paperwork

steps.what: Read notes on clients that the report will quote
State the findings, the conclusion and the outside recipient
Write draft reports on clients from the findings and quoted notes

loop.input: Quoted note spans from s1 and the findings, conclusion and recipient she stated in s2
loop.output: A draft report on this client
loop.check: Every clinical sentence quotes a note she opened in s1 or repeats a finding or conclusion she stated in s2. Drop a diagnosis, a test score, a risk level, a recommendation, or a source that is not in the file.
loop.stop: One report for this client, then stop. If a required finding is missing, leave that section blank.
loop.why_not_simpler: The report prose is not a fixed form. A template cannot decide which note sentence supports a finding.

steps.what: Correct the client report against the quoted notes
Send the accepted report to the named outside recipient
Maintain the required paperwork with the send date and recipient

tasks.design: She reads the notes she will quote in {DOCS} and states the findings, the conclusion and the recipient. A bounded draft writes the report from those facts, and she corrects it. A gated send in {EMAIL} goes only to the outside recipient she named, and a separate gated line in the care record in {OTHER} records the send date and recipient as the required paperwork.
tasks.previous_blocker: The report had to be written from notes she chose, and a draft could invent a source she never opened.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft can propose prose that is forced to quote a note she opened or repeat a finding she stated, and she still edits the version that leaves.
tasks.still_hard: She must still choose the findings and the recipient, and she must still correct the report before it is sent.
tasks.human_edge: She is the editor of the version that leaves. A sentence with no note and no stated finding does not go out.
tasks.altitude: She still decides the findings and signs the report. She no longer writes the first prose or retypes the send into a second register.

reach.task: Decide what a letter to a school may contain
reach.learn: Which findings from the clinical report may be told to a school, and which may not

evidence.claim: A drafted report can add a source that was not in the file. A public case of a report with fabricated references was partly refunded. The check drops any source she did not open. That case is not a time cut.
The psychologist stays accountable for test reports drafted with AI.
Reports that quote session notes or test results carry health data under GDPR Article 9.
AI Act Article 50 requires that AI text informing the public be disclosed unless a human is the editor. She edits the version she sends.

assumptions: s1 produces the quoted note spans. s2 produces finding, conclusion and recipient. The draft may use only those.
The recipient on s5 is outside the organisation, such as the patient, a referrer, an insurer or a court. An internal case conference is not this send.
s6 is a second register in the care record, not the report file she already corrected. If the paperwork is only a save in that same file, s6 does not run.
Both the send and the log bind the report text as corrected at s4, and the recipient she confirmed there. A later edit voids both.
She does not maintain a report template after the build. Focal upkeep is zero. Her editing time sits in s4.
Any staff consultation about the draft follows national rules. She remains the editor, so the outside text is not an unedited machine text.
unknowns: Which recipients sit outside the organisation, and whether the paperwork log is a second register.
research_questions: What share of these reports is sent outside, rather than kept for an internal case conference?

already_counted.description: Reading the notes, stating the findings and correcting the report stay her time.

incremental.description: No ongoing template upkeep. A template change is a new build. Editing stays in the review step.

approvals.approved_version: The report text as corrected at s4, to the recipient she confirmed at s4. A later edit voids the send.
The same corrected report text and the same confirmed recipient, plus the send date of that version. A later edit voids the paperwork line.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If there is no outside recipient and she writes the report herself in the care record, the draft, the send and the log do not run. If she has notes to quote, has stated the findings, and the recipient is outside, most of the draft and the send return. The log returns only when the paperwork is a second register.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still interviews, judges harm, diagnoses, and signs the report. A note draft and a norm score do not decide.
skills_to_grow: State the harm in her own words and keep that call as hers.
State the recommendation and the plan change before a note draft, then correct the draft against what was said.
Enter raw scores before a norm lookup, and keep the diagnosis as her own statement.
State the findings, the conclusion and the recipient before a report draft, and send only the version she corrected.
role.ambitious_version: No unattended agent assesses harm, names a disorder, or sends a client report. A selection test and a staff survey are not this work.
